description: A reusable policy for supporting learners in asynchronous, self-paced online courses and programmes through mentors, coaches or instructors who are available on demand and who reach out proactively: what to set up at the start, which progress signals trigger contact, what a contact does, how automated outreach and AI help divide the work with people, and how to check who the support actually reaches.
title: Mentor Support in Self-Paced Online Learning
